digest.component_or_area: code-review criteria routing and blocking posture
propositions: The security criterion must transition from advisory (blocking_enabled: false) to blocking (blocking_enabled: true) at the derived threshold value from story 9f25, while all other non-DET LLM criteria remain advisory at 0.95.
Three blocking-set pinning test functions must be updated to assert the new approved blocking set {secret-detection, high-critical-security, security} and fail on any unapproved criterion addition.

A self-contained unit test (test_code_review_blocking_replay.py) must prove that security findings meeting the derived threshold now block while NIT-tier findings remain unblocked, without depending on external derivation artifacts.
ADR 0036 must be updated with a dated note documenting the conclusion of permissive rollout for the security criterion, citing derivation ticket 9f25.
The configuration change is threshold/posture only and must not alter pass-3 decide.py math or consequence-binary semantics.
